history.notes: LAN control: Control Method now offers RS-232, RS-232 + IR Power On, LAN, LAN + IR Power On and IR. LAN uses JVC's TCP 20554 handshake (PJ_OK, PJREQ, PJACK) per command, and Last Error names refused, silent, busy (PJ_NG) and password (PJNAK) cases. Existing RS-232 and IR projects keep their setting. A lens recall over LAN reports as sent, not as a No ACK, because the lens move outlasts the connection. · IR Power On assist: the + IR Power On methods send JVC's discrete IR Power On with every Power On, so a projector whose port sleeps in standby (ECO Mode On) still turns on; everything else stays two-way. A quiet port in standby reads as a note, not an error. New Test IR action sends the Info key to prove the emitter, the IR binding and the Remote Code, and "Projector IR is not bound" stays in Last Error until the output is bound. · Diagnosis: new Diagnose Link action and Link Diagnosis property print a verdict and a checklist, most likely cause first (port baud, binding, crossover cable, ECO Mode, Communication Terminal, Control4 setting). The driver also recognises and names echoes from a loopback plug or an echoing adapter. Counters restart at boot and on a Control Method change. · Read-backs: ECO Mode (plus Set ECO Mode), input signal (Signal Present and Signal Lost events), anamorphic, aspect, lamp power and the projector's own remote code are read into properties and variables. If the projector's remote code differs from the Remote Code property, Last Error names both. Lamp Alert Hours fires a Lamp Hours Alert event once per threshold. It takes effect as soon as it is changed and survives restarts. · Power reliability: a power command with no ACK is retried up to 4 times, 6 s apart. A command the projector ACKs but ignores is sent again after the 15 s grace window, even if Watch or Room Off is tapped again or alternated meanwhile. A Watch keeps its input through those retries. Power On from Unknown is sent even if the power query is not answered; Room Off from Unknown asks first. Set Picture Mode waits 10 s for its ACK. Warmup Time is now at least 25 s. · IR only: an Unknown model no longer refuses commands. Power On and Standby are always sent, so a projector switched off with the JVC remote can be brought back. After a re-sent Power On, the input key is sent again when Warmup Time ends, so the input still lands. Cooldown counts from the confirming second Standby. · Docs: the guide and catalog are rewritten for LAN, the IR assist, read-backs and Diagnose Link. Hardware claims the sources do not prove are hedged: Communication Terminal exclusivity, when Composer applies the serial settings, and Lamp On timing. Power On and Power Off events are documented as also firing when the state is relearned after a restart or a lost link. Correction to the 0.1.0 notes: declaring 19200 8N1 does not guarantee the bound port uses it, so check the port in Composer.
